background: Virgin Money UK PLC is the holding company of Clydesdale Bank, a UK retail and business bank trading as Virgin Money, which became part of Nationwide Building Society and is being folded into it.
synthesis: Ratings are A from Fitch, BBB+ from S&P after its upgrade on 29 Oct 2025 and A3 from Moody's, with the two outlooks given as stable. Capital is mixed against UK mid-sized banks: CET1 of 13.9% is at the median, while leverage of 6.1% is below the peer median. Liquidity is also mixed, with LCR of 155% below the peer median and NSFR of 141% in the top quarter. Leverage has risen 1.0 points since 30 Sep 2024 and the rest has been flat, but the figures run only to 30 Sep 2025, so they predate the company's absorption into Nationwide. Nothing has been flagged in the last 90 days. Nationwide's ownership is the main support.
